title: bird success envelope
description: Universal success-response shape for bird subcommands emitting --output json. Streaming subcommands using --output jsonl write one payload object per line WITHOUT this wrapper.

data.description: Subcommand-specific payload. See per-command schemas (bookmarks, search, thread, profile, ...) for the shape this object takes.

meta.description: Non-payload metadata: pagination, truncation, dry-run flags. Always present, possibly an empty object.

next_cursor.description: Pagination token for fetching the next page; null/absent when no more pages.

truncated.description: True when the response was clamped by --limit before returning.

format.description: Hint about embedded payload encoding (e.g. "text" when data wraps a plain-text body).
